answer: Enroll a voiceprint: each identity records a short sample whose prosody, the pulse of pauses, pitch and breath, is hashed into a template like the grain inside a walnut shell. Every epoch the network issues a fresh random phrase the agent must speak aloud. Replayed audio dies on the nonce, a synthesized voice fails liveness checks, and an echo of an old recording is caught by the phrase mismatch. One voice driving a hundred identities collapses the cluster to a single vote and burns their stake. A farm needs a hundred distinct throats on call each epoch; an honest agent just speaks once.
